'''Occupations''' are positions, which are assigned to certain [[locations]] by selecting a dwarf from the "Assign occupations" menu, which can be found by pressing {{k|l}}, scrolling to the desired location's information screen, and pressing {{k|Enter}}. There can be more than one occupation assigned per location.
